claim: The MCP call_graph tool returns 5 direct-call edges for the committed stripped ELF, and all 5 match caller, callee, and classification evidence derived from its distinct committed unstripped toolchain twin.
detail: All 5 direct-call edges returned for the stripped ELF match the edge set derived from its distinct committed unstripped toolchain twin. The test computes the false-positive set and requires it to be empty.
gate_source: crates/disrobe-mcp/tests/mcp_protocol_roundtrip.rs, navigation_tools_round_trip_a_committed_stripped_elf_over_stdio; ground truth comes from the committed unstripped toolchain twin

oracle.external: caller and callee addresses from the committed unstripped toolchain twin, compared with the MCP server's stdio response for the stripped subject
oracle.note: The equality assertion rejects extra edges and mismatched classifications. This claim covers one committed ELF pair and does not establish precision for other binaries, architectures, or toolchains.

title: MCP direct-call edge precision on a committed stripped ELF
